newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- United Arab Emirates' Central Bank moves to allow setting up of an Islamic bank in Abu Dhabi.
- Saudi Arabia to sign trade deals with South Africa during a visit to the kingdom by a South African trade team.
- Gulf Cooperation Council states study the setting up of a company to market small industrial products.
- Saudi Interior Minister Prince Nayef carries proposals to settle border dispute with Yemen.
- Jordan to offer projects worth $4 billion at Cairo's economic summit.
- Around 200,000 illegal workers left the United Arab Emirates.
